extra_quotes: We performed first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations within the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP)[35, 36] using the pseudopotentials derived from projected augmented wave (PAW) method[37, 38] to describe the interactions between the core and valance electrons.
The lattice thermal conductivity (κl) is calculated based on Wigner formalism proposed by Simoncelli et al. [49, 50], implemented in the Phono3py package [45, 51].

The electronic transport properties, including the electrical conductivity (σ), Seebeck coefficient (S), and electronic thermal conductivity (κe), are evaluated by solving the Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) within the Onsager transport formalism, as implemented in the AMSET code[46].
We discarded the semimetallic compounds ZrHfIr2Bi2 and Hf2RhIrBi2 for further thermoelectric properties calculations due to the limitations of our computational methodology.
